name: wfh-attendance-root
description: Root package.json for WFH Attendance project

scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend/apps/gateway && npm install && cd ../user-service && npm install && cd ../attendance-service && npm install
scripts.start: npx concurrently "npm run start:fe" "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:user" "npm run start:attendance"
scripts.migrate: cd backend/apps/user-service && npm run migration:run && cd ../attendance-service && npm run migration:run
